*AI briefing, Monday, October 19*
Window: Fri Oct 16, about 8 AM PT, to Mon Oct 19, about 8 AM PT
Labs shipped two public updates, and a grid story explains where the machines go.

*Anthropic publishes a workforce study.*
Junior technical hires fell from 27% to 9% since early 2025. The lab published the study on its own site.
It is the first lab-reported data on how agents shift who gets hired.
<https://www.anthropic.com/research/employment-at-anthropic|Anthropic>

*Microsoft drops an Essex data center plan.*
Microsoft walked away from renting about 23,000 GPUs because the grid cannot deliver power until the 2030s.
Grid dates now gate capacity deals.
<https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2026/oct/18/microsoft-datacentre|The Guardian>
